mapper.select: SELECT m.id,m.name,m.parentId,m.createDate,m.createId,m.updateDate,m.sort,m.href,m.remark FROM menu m LEFT JOIN role_menu_rel rm ON m.id = rm.menuId WHERE rm.roleId=#{roleId} AND m.parentId=#{parentId} AND m.state = '1' ORDER BY m.sort
SELECT id, title, "content" AS "content", publishDate, roleId FROM information WHERE roleId = #{roleId} ORDER BY publishDate DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, title, "content" AS "content", publishDate, roleId FROM information WHERE roleId = #{roleId} ORDER BY publishDate DESC, id DESC
SELECT id,name,parentId,sort,href,state,remark FROM menu

SELECT c.id AS "id", c.name AS "name", COALESCE(t.teacherNum, 0) AS "teacherNum", COALESCE(s.studentNum, 0) AS "studentNum", c.state AS "state", c.createDate AS "createDate" FROM college c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT collegeId, COUNT(1) AS teacherNum FROM teacher GROUP BY collegeId ) t ON t.collegeId = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT collegeId, COUNT(1) AS studentNum FROM student GROUP BY collegeId ) s ON s.collegeId = c.id ORDER BY c.createDate
SELECT i.id AS "id", i.title AS "title", i."content" AS "content", i.publishDate AS "publishDate", i.roleId AS "roleId", r.name AS "roleName" FROM information i LEFT JOIN role r ON r.id = i.roleId

SELECT i.id AS "id", i.title AS "title", i."content" AS "content", i.publishDate AS "publishDate", i.roleId AS "roleId", r.name AS "roleName" FROM information i LEFT JOIN role r ON r.id = i.roleId WHERE i.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE information SET title=#{title}, "content"=#{content} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id,m.name,m.parentId,m.createDate,m.createId,m.updateDate,m.sort,m.href,m.remark FROM menu m LEFT JOIN role_menu_rel rm ON m.id = rm.menuId WHERE rm.roleId=#{roleId} AND m.state = '1' ORDER BY m.sort
SELECT m.id,m.name,m.parentId,m.createDate,m.createId,m.updateDate,m.sort,m.href,m.remark FROM menu m WHERE m.state = '1' ORDER BY m.sort
SELECT id,name,createDate,state FROM role
mapper.update: UPDATE manage_user SET username = #{username} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, loginName, username FROM manage_user WHERE loginName = #{loginName} AND password = #{password} AND state = '1'
mapper.update: UPDATE manage_user SET password = #{newPassword} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, academicYear, stageName, stageOrder, startDate, endDate, allowRecommend, allowPlan, allowOutside, state FROM selection_stage ORDER BY academicYear, stageOrder

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM college WHERE state = '1') AS "collegeCount", (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM teacher WHERE state = '1') AS "teacherCount", (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student WHERE state = '1') AS "studentCount", (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM course WHERE state = '1') AS "courseCount", (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_course_rel) AS "selectionCount", (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_course_rel WHERE state = '1') AS "scoredCount", (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_course_rel WHERE state = '0') AS "unscoredCount", (SELECT academicYear FROM course_academic_year WHERE state = '1' LIMIT 1) AS "academicYear"
SELECT c.name AS "collegeName", COUNT(s.id) AS "studentCount" FROM college c LEFT JOIN student s ON s.collegeId = c.id AND s.state = '1' WHERE c.state = '1' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.name

SELECT co.name AS "collegeName", COUNT(sc.id) AS "selectionCount", COUNT(DISTINCT sc.studentId) AS "studentCount" FROM college co LEFT JOIN course c ON c.collegeId = co.id AND c.state = '1' LEFT JOIN student_course_rel sc ON sc.courseId = c.id WHERE co.state = '1' GROUP BY co.id, co.name ORDER BY COUNT(sc.id) DESC, co.name

SELECT c.courseName AS "courseName", co.name AS "collegeName", c.optional AS "optional", COUNT(sc.id) AS "selectionCount" FROM course c LEFT JOIN college co ON co.id = c.collegeId LEFT JOIN student_course_rel sc ON sc.courseId = c.id WHERE c.state = '1' GROUP BY c.id, c.courseName, co.name, c.optional ORDER BY COUNT(sc.id) DESC, c.courseName LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN sc.selectionType = 'plan' THEN '方案内选课' WHEN sc.selectionType = 'outside' THEN '方案外选课' ELSE '推荐选课' END AS "typeName", COUNT(1) AS "selectionCount" FROM student_course_rel sc GROUP BY CASE WHEN sc.selectionType = 'plan' THEN '方案内选课' WHEN sc.selectionType = 'outside' THEN '方案外选课' ELSE '推荐选课' END
SELECT '已评分' AS "statusName", COUNT(1) AS "count" FROM student_course_rel WHERE state = '1' UNION ALL SELECT '未评分' AS "statusName", COUNT(1) AS "count" FROM student_course_rel WHERE state = '0'
